newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 622c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 4c to 622c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose four cents to 622 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney and Adelaide, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was dearer, with 19/25/26 microns slightly dearer, 20/21/24m one percent dearer, and 22/23m 0.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were generally unchanged, it said.
In crossbreds, 27/30m were slightly dearer, 28m 0.5 percent dearer, 29m unchanged, and 31m up to 1.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, with locks and crutchings generally unchanged.
WI said Japanese interests including China were principal buyers with good support from local mills and Taiwan.
Of the 22,139 bales offered, 7.8 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 82,300 bales to be offered.
